ext.config.node.path.title: Node.js binary path
ext.config.cli.path.description:
Path to the LikeC4 CLI used by **Copy as PNG** and **Save as PNG** (e.g. `node_modules/likec4/bin/likec4.mjs` or a global `likec4` executable). Relative paths resolve against the workspace folder.  
If empty, the extension resolves the `likec4` package installed in the project (Yarn PnP: `yarn likec4`). `.js`/`.mjs` entries run with `#likec4.node.path#`.
